name: Plank
summary: A static hold that trains the abs and trunk to resist sagging, building core stability for many other lifts.
setup: Lie face down and place the forearms on the floor with elbows under the shoulders.
Extend the legs behind you with toes on the floor.
Lift the body so it forms a straight line from head to heels.
execution: Squeeze the glutes and brace the abs as if preparing for a light punch.
Keep the neck neutral and look at the floor between the hands.
Hold the position while breathing steadily.
Lower to the floor under control when form breaks.
mistakes: Sagging hips: squeeze the glutes and shorten the hold.
Hips piked high: lower them until the body is in a straight line.
Holding the breath: breathe slowly and steadily.
Looking forward and lifting the head: keep the neck in line with the spine.
